title: verification team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/verification.yaml: the team layer of the verification plugin's settings. Resolution and the stricter-wins rule: plugins/verification/reference/config.md. Contract: docs/adr/0054-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

proof_level.description: How much evidence /verification:confirm requires before a CONFIRMED verdict. path: a live run only for a change on a runtime-affecting path. live: a live drive for any change with a runnable surface when the app can be launched, else the non-UI check that proves the change. strict: a unit, a live and a performance box per plan phase, each holding evidence or a reasoned not-applicable line. Unlike a later-layer key, the stricter of this value and the user's option wins (path < live < strict), and this file is read from the default branch's committed copy, so a branch cannot lower it for its own run.
